dnaPage.title: DNA
dnaPage.intro: Every marker the knowledge base describes, most clinically useful first: established findings before preliminary ones, medical before lifestyle. Filter by person and area, then copy or share what you see with ChatGPT, Claude or any assistant.
dnaPage.noDna: No DNA imported yet. The list shows what each marker means; import a raw DNA file to see genotypes.
dnaPage.evidenceLegend: Evidence: A = clinical guideline or well replicated, B = replicated association, C = preliminary. Coloured genotypes have impact 2 or more.
dnaPage.sendIntro: The context pack holds the markers shown above for the selected people, or only the ones you tick, pseudonymised unless you switch real names on. Narrow the filters or tick markers to send less.
dnaPage.question: Question (optional)
dnaPage.picked: Ticked markers: {n}. Only these go into the context pack.
